jobs.prompt: In docs/design/command-center-mockup/hive.html the card builder (inside NODES.forEach, around the lines that create const bd = el('div', 'hive-node-bd')) builds the card body bd with the key/value list and the p() meter but never appends bd to the card, so every card renders with an empty body. Add the missing card.appendChild(bd); right after the meter block and before card.style.setProperty('--card-glow', ...). Then check that the card body is laid out correctly: .hive-node must be a flex column so the header, the body (flex:1, padding 8px 10px, no overflow hidden) and the meter fit inside the 18.8 percent stage-height cards at 1440x900 and in the single-column phone layout at 390px; adjust the .hive-kv, .hive-node-bd and .hive-meter CSS only as far as needed so three rows of 12.5px mono and the meter are fully visible (never clipped). Change nothing else.
